title: The bird and Gully
logline: Three days into the dock sequence: Gully on the dock with his coffee, drawn whole, and on the piling beside him the bird, which he does not look at. The book prints it facing the dock's first page.

panels.composition: Gully heavy and gray on the dock with a coffee looking at the water, and on the piling beside him the small rainbow bird, which he does not look at. The ramp beyond.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a heavy gray-haired man in a canvas jacket standing on a dock with a coffee looking at the water while a small rainbow bird sits on the piling beside him unlooked at, a plank ramp beyond, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Facing the dock's first page. Gully doesn't look.
